svg.title: Sinan Tüfekci
svg.desc: Sinan Tüfekci, mechatronics engineer building robots end to end, from firmware and PCBs to control and the tools around them. Beside the name, a microcontroller sends pulses along copper traces to a driver and a two-link robot arm, whose pen draws the profile of a cycloidal disc.
svg.text: Mechatronics engineer · robots, end to end
